CustomField.description: The identifier, name, or path of the item to evaluate. The required format depends on the 'Type' field. For Custom Permission type: unprefixed names check local/subscriber permissions, 'core.' prefix checks package permissions, and 'namespace__' syntax checks fully-qualified namespaced permissions. For Permission Set Group type: the API name of a permission set or the developer name of a permission set group, matched against the user's direct assignments. For Public Group type: the group's API name, which Setup shows as Group Name. A group label also works if exactly one public group has that label, and the log then shows a warning.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Format depends on Type. Profile: profile name. Permission Set Group: permission set API name or group developer name. Custom Permission: API name (use core.Name for package permissions). Public Group: group API name (Group Name in Setup); a label works only if one public group has it, with a log warning. Hierarchical CS: Object.Field. List CS: Object.Name.Field. Custom Metadata: Object.DevName.Field.
